title: Let the Guru's way outrank the powerful
summary: The Guru's way outweighs millions of worldly rewards. Do not let worldly power outrank the Guru's path.
takeaway: Do not let worldly power outrank the Guru's path.
lifeApplication: When impressive people pull your attention, remember what cannot do your inner work and return to the Guru's way.

source.shortMeaning: The Guru's way outweighs millions of worldly rewards.
